source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 (ISLB A1) · lesson 8. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: Revelation (wahy) and the books Allah sent

learn.en: Allah's guidance to people is called wahy, which means revelation. Angel Jibreel brought it to the prophets.
learn.title: Wahy: a gift from Allah

learn.en: The Suhuf were given to Prophet Ibrahim, and the Zabur to Prophet Dawud.
learn.title: Suhuf and Zabur

learn.en: The Tawrah was given to Prophet Musa, and the Injil to Prophet Isa.
learn.title: Tawrah and Injil

learn.en: The Qur'an was given to our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. It is the last book Allah will ever send.
learn.title: The Qur'an

learn.en: All these books had one message: Tawheed — there is no god but Allah.
learn.title: One message

learn.en: The older books were lost or changed by people. Allah Himself protects the Qur'an, word for word.
learn.title: Protected by Allah

learn.en: A new computer comes with a manual from its maker. Allah's books are the manual for our hearts and lives.
learn.title: Like a manual

order.en: Put the books in the order they were sent

quiz.en: Which book was given to Prophet Muhammad ﷺ?
What one message did all the books teach?
opts: How to build a big ship
Tawheed: there is no god but Allah

quiz.en: True or false? Allah left us in the dark to figure out the world all by ourselves.
True or false? The Zabur was given to Prophet Dawud.
True or false? The Qur'an will one day be lost or changed like the older books.

think.q: You got a new robot with lots of buttons. What do you read to learn how it works? How is the Qur'an like that?
think.a: The manual! The Qur'an is like the manual from our Maker, telling us how to live safely and happily.

parents.summary: Revelation (waḥy) came through Jibreel; the Suhuf, Zabur, Tawrah, Injil and Qur'an; the Qur'an is protected and final.
parents.tip: Match each book with its prophet together, out loud, at dinner.
